name: codex-remote
description: Pair ChatGPT Android or iPhone with terminal Codex and manage remote access without restarting sessions.

interface.longDescription: Pair terminal Codex on your computer with the official ChatGPT app on Android or iPhone. Show a short-lived pairing QR, check remote-access status, and manage paired devices through six local MCP tools. Access uses the existing native Codex service and stays enabled until explicitly disabled. Existing sessions and pairings are preserved when a new QR is requested. Requires the standalone Codex Remote CLI, Node 24+, and a compatible native Codex remote-control interface. Linux/Android existing-chat messaging is verified; other platforms and new phone-created threads remain unverified. Optional /qr autocomplete requires Codex Command Extensions. Community project by Cheaux; not maintained or endorsed by OpenAI.
defaultPrompt: Show the QR for remote session pairing.
Check whether my phone is paired with this Codex host.
